sourceName: The Journal of Writing and Artificial Intelligence
title: A new journal creates a dedicated home for research on writing and AI
friendlyTitle: A new journal will study how AI changes writing
summary: The Journal of Writing and Artificial Intelligence has opened as a publication focused on the intersection of AI with academic and professional writing. It is inviting submissions for a field now spanning authorship, teaching, assessment, workplace practice and tool design.
friendlySummary: The Journal of Writing and Artificial Intelligence is accepting work about AI in academic and professional writing.
whyItMatters: Writing tools are changing faster than shared standards for evidence, disclosure and evaluation. A specialist venue can help practitioners follow sustained research rather than relying on product demonstrations, although its editorial record will need to establish itself over time.
friendlyWhyItMatters: We need evidence about how AI affects writing, learning and work. This journal could collect that research, but readers should judge its quality as it develops.
